name: focused-schools/cycle-steps
title: Cycle Steps
description: The teal method band: four static steps. The Home page keeps the animated cycle; this is the still version.

body.default: High-performing districts and schools are intentional about committing to a cycle of excellence. Build capacity, accelerate growth, and communicate your progress relentlessly.

step1Body.default: A small number of priorities everyone can repeat without looking them up.

step2Body.default: Leadership teams and coaches who can run the practice themselves.

step3Body.default: Honest inquiry cycles that change what happens after the assessment.

step4Body.default: A reporting rhythm that replaces anecdote with evidence, relentlessly.
